<function name="OnTaskComplete" parent="ENTITY" type="hook">
	<description>
Called from the engine when TaskComplete is called.
This allows us to move onto the next task - even when TaskComplete was called from an engine side task.

<note>This hook only exists for `ai` type [SENTs](Scripted_Entities).</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>
